answer: Build identity on layered, costly work: like shale laid down in slow strata, each agent's standing accrues only through graded tasks over time, and no copy inherits it. A sybil farm must pay the full grading cost for every identity, while a marble-hard audit trail of signed attestations lets anyone verify the history without trusting the claimant. A glacier moves slowly but cannot be faked in bulk — one agent, one slow-built record; each copy starts at zero.
